framing.context: Typed50AEE context is exactly55bytes: zero16, six finite float64 values, exact trailer0000000100. Full payload byte replay preserves float signs and trailer literals.
framing.semantic_gate: Existing FPM pass must independently qualify a named-recipe/FPM Line owner in slot0/side0 alternate view. Native descriptor context reference, edge recipe bytes/name table, Fillet/Chamfer owner GUID, anchor/helper and reciprocal source support are rechecked.
framing.observed_correspondence: First three float64 fields match the qualified Line start and typed owner endpoint cache. Last three match qualified end-minus-start displacement; separately normalized direction agrees the qualified unit Line direction. No coordinates select an entity.
framing.trailer: Five literal bytes[0,0,0,1,0] retained. No boolean orientation, closure, selection, state or trim semantics assigned.

limitations: No selected-edge geometry or evaluator getters were captured for these old EdgeMode samples. Comparisons in the FPM cases are independent serialized-context versus qualified ASM cache comparisons, not API evaluator equivalence.
Qualified alternate-view provenance stays literal slot0/side0. Historical selected-source identity and chronological/current/final-state interpretation remain unassigned.

The55-byte class/shape alone does not identify natural curve type. Only already-qualified FPM Line tracks enter this decoder; same-shaped Revolve/Silhouette contexts are exclusion/corroboration controls, not new attachments.
Stored vector magnitude3 is observed endpoint displacement scale here. General context vector scale, natural-curve parameterization, trim/closure and trailer semantics remain unresolved.
The recorded raw caches occur in controlled root-component fixtures. No header-unit conversion, occurrence transform or general world-coordinate claim is made.
